Crypto taxes sit where finance, law and technology meet. We combine all three: software that reads every chain you use, accountants who specialise in digital assets and a clear process that keeps you informed from the first import to the filed return.

Connect exchanges and wallets in a few clicks or upload your files. We pull in your full history, including DeFi, NFTs and staking, and match transfers between your own accounts so nothing is counted twice.

Our AI engine labels every transaction and applies the tax rules of your country, from swaps and airdrops to lending interest. Our specialists check the unusual cases, so you get speed without guesswork.
Download a ready-to-file report, share it with your own accountant or let ours submit it for you. Your data stays up to date, so next year starts where this one ends.
Spot missing records, unmatched transfers and unrealised losses early. We show how each issue affects your tax bill and fix it long before it turns into a question from the tax office.
Find legal ways to pay less: harvest losses before the year ends, time sales around holding periods and claim every deductible fee you paid on exchanges and networks.
Watch your estimated tax for the year change as the market moves, plan sales with real numbers in front of you and set aside the right amount for every payment.
